what_happened.line: The Historical Commission voted 3-0 to send the demolition request for 400 Howard Street to an 18-month demolition delay.
The chair is to notify the building department of the delay vote the next day.
After the prior chair resigned, members voted for a new chair and vice chair; a secretary was nominated in his absence, with counts not stated for the last two.
Members agreed a professional should be hired for the survey of homes forms, and one member will research the cost and report back.
The chair is to get tree removal prices for the lost cemetery memorial; no next meeting date is set.

why_it_matters: The delay on 400 Howard Street holds off demolition of a historic house while alternatives can be considered, which affects what may happen to that property and neighborhood.
The commission's survey of homes work and cemetery restoration may call for town money or other funds, so a funding vote could come before residents' boards.
